description: Use this when someone asks what size of sofa or sectional fits a living room. Calculates the longest sofa or L sectional for a wall, with 36 in walkways past its ends (NKBA) and 22 in end tables beside it: its length (up to 110 in for a sofa, 156 × 120 in for an L), the number of seats (22 in each after 3 in arms), the sofa depths the room allows in front of a coffee table and a TV unit, the coffee table (two thirds of the sofa, 12 to 18 in from it), the viewing distance to the TV, the TV size that fills 30° to 40° of the view (SMPTE), and, for a given TV, the best distance and whether the seat lies within it.

depth.description: Distance from the wall behind the sofa to the wall with the TV, in millimeters.

endTable.description: Width of an end table; 558.8 (22 in) without it, in millimeters.

shape.description: A straight sofa, or an L sectional with its short side along the left wall; sofa without it.

tables.description: End tables beside the sofa: 0, 1 at the left end, or 2; 1 without it.

tv.description: Diagonal of the TV, in inches.

walkway.description: Width of a walkway; 914.4 (36 in) without it, in millimeters.

walkways.description: Walkways past the sofa's ends: 0, 1 at the right end, or 2; 1 without it.

wall.description: Length of the wall behind the sofa, inside the walls, in millimeters.

name: calculate_sofa_size
title: Sofa size calculator
